title: Bigoli with Italian-Style Scrambled Eggs
description: A classic Italian pasta dish with a twist, featuring bigoli pasta tossed in a rich egg scramble.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bigoli according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the cooked bigoli to the bowl with the eggs and toss to combine.
Add the egg mixture to the skillet with the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until the eggs are scrambled and set.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
